Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated the content of the search results. In the actual DuckDuckGo search results for "Heading to the Ground 2009 MBC cast", the main cast listed is Jung Yun-ho, Go Ara, Lee Yoon-ji, and Lee Sang-yoon. There is no mention of a TVXQ member (Shim Chang-min, Kim Jaejoong, etc.) in that specific snippet. The WebSurfer incorrectly claimed the text read "The main cast of Heading to the Ground includes U-Know from TVXQ...", which is false. Based on this fabricated evidence, the Planner subsequently deduced the wrong actor (Shim Chang-min played *Dream High*, not Heading to the Ground; the actual TVXQ member in Heading to the Ground is **Kim Jaejoong**).
